subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------PROJ.DY.
description: Diagram in the White Improvisor section (WI-7), where Braxton argues that 'the educational route of the white improvisor must be viewed on several different levels' and that the university 'mirrors the information position of western culture' rather than the essence umbrella of black creativity. C-INFO (composite information) is crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics): the question is what composite information becomes when its projectional dynamics route through institutional pedagogy rather than community-experience. C-INFO → PROJ-DY (the crossing). C-INFO also branches to MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) → INFO-DE (information degrees) → INFO-F (information focus) → (P)ATTN (the point of idea completion of attraction). A third branch leads to PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism), which branches to TH-CONT (thrust continuance) and to (C)PART (the concept of participation) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). The diagram thus diagrams the white improvisor's distinctive informational landscape: participation is conceptual (the (c) prefix marking it as concept-grade rather than embodied).
